package.description: The clusterctl CLI tool handles the lifecycle of a Cluster API management cluster.

en-US.description: The clusterctl CLI tool handles the lifecycle of a Cluster API management cluster.
en-US.longDescription: The clusterctl CLI tool handles the lifecycle of a Cluster API management cluster.
en-US.name: clusterctl
en-US.releaseNotes:
## 👌 Kubernetes version support

• Management Cluster：v1.33.x -> v1.37.x
• Workload Cluster：v1.31.x -> v1.37.x

[More information about version support can be found here](https://cluster-api.sigs.k8s.io/reference/versions.html)

## Changes since v1.14.3
## :chart_with_upwards_trend：Overview
• 13 new commits merged
• 5 bugs fixed 🐛

## :bug：Bug Fixes
• Cluster：Also set cluster-name label even if BeforeClusterCreate hook is blocking (#14326)
• Cluster：Fix ControlPlaneInitialized reason when the control plane does not exist (#14437)
• clusterctl：Fix clusterctl listing of resources whose kind ends in List (#14358)
• KCP：Support KCP in-place updates when coredns and kube-proxy phases are skipped (#14364)
• Machine：Stop checking kubelet version against an empty version (#14414)

## :seedling：Others
• CI：Fallback to alternate locations for Trivy DB (#14411)
• ClusterCache：Reject file-based credentials in kubeconfigs (#14434)
• clusterctl：Bump cert-manager to v1.21.3 (#14440)
• Dependency：Bump corefile-migration to v1.0.36 (#14418)
• Dependency：Bump go to 1.26.10 (#14393)
• e2e：Pin kind binary version and download exact version (#14338)
• Security：Bump go to 1.26.9 and dependencies for security (#14361)
• Security：Fix typo in trivy DB mirror (#14448)

## Dependencies

### Added
_Nothing has changed._

### Changed
• github.com/coredns/corefile-migration：[v1.0.35 → v1.0.36](https://github.com/coredns/corefile-migration/compare/v1.0.35...v1.0.36)
• golang.org/x/crypto：v0.56.0 → v0.57.0
• golang.org/x/mod：v0.38.0 → v0.41.0
• golang.org/x/net：v0.58.0 → v0.60.0
• golang.org/x/sync：v0.22.0 → v0.23.0
• golang.org/x/sys：v0.47.0 → v0.48.0
• golang.org/x/telemetry：49f421f → a038080
• golang.org/x/term：v0.45.0 → v0.46.0
• golang.org/x/text：v0.41.0 → v0.42.0
• golang.org/x/tools：v0.48.0 → v0.49.0

### Removed
_Nothing has changed._

_Thanks to all our contributors!_ 😊
